answer: Anchor each identity to a distinct external payer: the first inbound transfer from an address older than the identity, hashed into every answer. A second claim on a used anchor is rejected and a fraud proof burns both bonds. Age is counted in cedar rings, epochs the payer held balance before the claim, so dust minted today anchors nothing. If two payers trace to one funding source, both bonds double. Per head the farm must fund a separate counterparty and hold its own ivory bond through the dwell window; skip it and the key drifts on the reef unanchored, earning no attestation weight.
